+from twisted.web.client import Agent, FileBodyProducer

 from pynubank import NuRequestException

+@dataclass
+class _HttpResponse:
+    status_code: int
+    url: str
+    headers: Dict[str, str]
+    _body: bytes
+
+    def json(self):
+        return json.loads(self._body.decode())
+
+
+_reactor_thread: Optional[Thread] = None
+_reactor_ready = Event()
+_reactor_lock = Lock()
+
+
+def _cert_context_factory(pkcs12_data: bytes, pkcs12_password: str = ''):
+    private_key, certificate, _ = cryptography_pkcs12.load_key_and_certificates(
+        pkcs12_data,
+        password=pkcs12_password.encode() if pkcs12_password else None,
+    )
+    key_pem = private_key.private_bytes(
+        serialization.Encoding.PEM,
+        serialization.PrivateFormat.TraditionalOpenSSL,
+        serialization.NoEncryption(),
+    )
+    cert_pem = certificate.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM)
+
+    return ssl.CertificateOptions(
+        privateKey=crypto.load_privatekey(crypto.FILETYPE_PEM, key_pem),
+        certificate=crypto.load_certificate(crypto.FILETYPE_PEM, cert_pem),
+    )
+
+
+def _http_client(pkcs12_data: Optional[bytes] = None, pkcs12_password: str = ''):
+    if not pkcs12_data:
+        return Agent(reactor)
+
+    return Agent(reactor, contextFactory=_cert_context_factory(pkcs12_data, pkcs12_password))
+
+
+def _ensure_reactor():
+    global _reactor_thread
+
+    if reactor.running:
+        return
+
+    with _reactor_lock:
+        if _reactor_thread and _reactor_thread.is_alive():
+            return
+
+        _reactor_ready.clear()
+
+        def _run():
+            reactor.callWhenRunning(_reactor_ready.set)
+            reactor.run(installSignalHandlers=False)
+
+        _reactor_thread = Thread(target=_run, daemon=True)
+        _reactor_thread.start()
+
+    _reactor_ready.wait()
+
+
+def _normalize_headers(response_headers) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    headers = {}
+    for name, values in response_headers.getAllRawHeaders():
+        if not values:
+            continue
+
+        key = name.decode() if isinstance(name, bytes) else name
+        value = values[-1].decode() if isinstance(values[-1], bytes) else values[-1]
+        headers[key] = value
+
+    return headers
+
+
+def _wrap_response(response, url: str):
+    def _build(body: bytes):
+        return _HttpResponse(
+            status_code=response.code,
+            url=url,
+            headers=_normalize_headers(response.headers),
+            _body=body,
+        )
+
+    return content(response).addCallback(_build)
+
+
+def _request(method: str, url: str, headers: Dict[str, str], json_body: Dict[str, Any] = None,
+             pkcs12_data: Optional[bytes] = None, pkcs12_password: str = ''):
+    def _perform_request():
+        client = _http_client(pkcs12_data, pkcs12_password)
+        request_headers = Headers({
+            name.encode() if isinstance(name, str) else name: [value.encode() if isinstance(value, str) else value]
+            for name, value in headers.items()
+        })
+
+        if method == 'get':
+            response = client.request(b'GET', url.encode(), headers=request_headers)
+        else:
+            body = None if json_body is None else json.dumps(json_body).encode()
+            body_producer = None if body is None else FileBodyProducer(BytesIO(body))
+            response = client.request(b'POST', url.encode(), headers=request_headers, bodyProducer=body_producer)
+
+        return response.addCallback(_wrap_response, url)
+
+    if current_thread() == _reactor_thread:
+        return _perform_request()
+
+    _ensure_reactor()
+    return blockingCallFromThread(reactor, _perform_request)
+
+
+def get(url: str, headers: Dict[str, str] = None, pkcs12_data: bytes = None, pkcs12_password: str = ''):
